Marian Grzymisławski

Marian Grzymisławski was a Polish internist who made significant contributions to the field of internal medicine. Career

Grzymisławski worked as a faculty member at the Poznań University of Medical Sciences, a prestigious medical school in Poland. During his tenure, he taught and conducted research in the department of internal medicine, sharing his expertise with students and colleagues alike. According to a publication by the Polish Academy of Sciences, Grzymisławski was a member of the faculty at the Poznań University of Medical Sciences, where he played an active role in shaping the institution's academic programs and research initiatives. [1]

Additionally, a biography published by the Polish Medical Association confirms Grzymisławski's affiliation with the Poznań University of Medical Sciences, highlighting his dedication to medical education and research. [2]
